'''''Glayyd''''' was one of seven [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] launched from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thokos]]. More than ten thousand years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Glayyd'' and the other ships landed on the planet [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. Like the colonists from the other ships, the ones who arrived on the ''Glayyd'' lost contact with Thokos, eventually formed a clan and named it after the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on which they arrived. The [[House Glayyd]] would feud with the other [[Ammuud clans]] for millennia to come.<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
